description: The extensions one database of an instance can use, and which are installed. tier "trusted" ones are installed as the database owner into public; "on_request" ones (vector among them) into a schema named extensions that is on the search path; "locked" ones are always there. Also lists the instance's databases.

id.description: Instance id, as returned by list_instances

name: list_extensions
title: List a PostgreSQL database's extensions
